Subject: Initial request: evidence scope and timeline for Acme Payments engagement

Hi Grace,

Thanks for agreeing to kick off the compliance intake for Acme Payments. We are preparing the scope for the upcoming FedRAMP readiness assessment and an ISO 27001 gap analysis. A couple of quick questions to help us shape the intake:  

- Do you have an internal owner for ISO 27001 controls mapping and evidence collection? If so, who will be our point of contact?
- Is there an existing evidence matrix or control repository you prefer we use (e.g., Drive, Confluence)?
- Can you confirm your preferred audit window (June 20 — July 2) and whether a narrower sampling window is required?
- Any known gaps around key control areas we should triage first (KMS, personnel access, logging retention)?

We are attaching our standard intake checklist. Happy to run a 30-minute rundown this week if that helps.

Best,
Bob
Senior Audit Lead, Acme Security
